summary_en: The Shiga Bank raised its dividend forecast for fiscal year ending March 2027 to 55 yen per share (annual), up 5 yen from the previous forecast of 50 yen, following an upward revision of earnings guidance. Interim dividend was increased to 27.50 yen per share from 25.00 yen, with the year-end dividend also raised to 27.50 yen.
title_en: Notice regarding Revision of Earnings Forecast, Determination of Interim Dividend, and Revision of Year-end Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
The Shiga Bank announced revisions to its financial guidance and dividend policy for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027. The bank raised its consolidated operating profit forecast to 45.8 billion yen from 42.1 billion yen, and net income attributable to parent company shareholders to 31.5 billion yen from 28.5 billion yen, reflecting stronger-than-expected performance in loan interest income and securities interest dividend income.

In conjunction with the upward earnings revision, the board approved an interim dividend of 27.50 yen per share for the period ended September 30, 2026, up from 25.00 yen. The bank also raised its full-year dividend forecast to 55.00 yen per share, consisting of 27.50 yen for the interim period and 27.50 yen for the year-end dividend, representing a 5.00 yen increase from the previous forecast of 50.00 yen. Both the interim and year-end dividends were increased by 2.50 yen per share. The interim dividend is payable on December 10, 2026, with the record date of September 30, 2026.
